info.title: reviewgraph – turn a C# pull request into a storyline graph for reviewers
info.description: Turns a C# pull request into a storyline graph: changed methods as cards, calls as arrows, entry point to data.

options.name: --base
options.description: Branch or commit the PR merges into (default: main, then master).

options.name: --head
options.description:
Commit to compare (default: the working tree, including uncommitted edits).
Must be the commit that is checked out.

options.name: --solution
options.description:
.sln or .csproj to load (default: first .sln in the repo root,
otherwise every .csproj).

options.name: --out
options.description: Self-contained viewer page to write (default: review.html).

options.name: --json
options.description: Also write the raw graph JSON.

options.name: --title
options.description: PR title (default: subject of the latest commit).

options.name: --source-only
options.description:
Skip MSBuild and compile the .cs files directly. Faster, works
without a restore, but types from NuGet packages go unresolved.
